༄༅/ /gshin rje du ba dum bu'i las byang bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// gshin rje du ba dum bu'i las byang bzhugs so//

ya mā ri na mo/ gshin rje du ba dum bu sgrub pa'i las byang ni/ bca' bzhi rnams gzhung dang man ngag ltar bya zhing*/ sman rak+ta gtor mchod rnams bshams/ nub dang po phyogs skyong dang gzhi bdag /bgegs la gtor ma cha gsum byin nas bka' bsgo/ skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ a+ye/ bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can ma lus pa// rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam gshin rje'i gshed// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sangs rgyas chos tshogs dang*// dam can srung mar bcas la skyabs su mchi// lan gsum| sems bskyed pa ni/ a+ye/ ma rig rgyu las log rtog rkyen dbang gis// sdug bsngal 'khor bar gnas pa'i 'gro ba rnams// bsgral nas byang chub sa la 'god pa'i phyir// 'jam dpal gshin rje'i go 'phang thob par bgyi// lan gsum/ yan lag bdun pa ni/ a+ye/ rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam gshin rje'i gshed// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sangs rgyas chos tshogs dang*// dam can rgya mtsho 'dir gshegs gdan la bzhugs// gus pas phyag 'tshal phyi nang gsang mchod 'bul// nyes sgrib mthol bshags dge la rjes yi rang*// gang 'dul chos gsung bskul gsol ji srid bar| |mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol dus gsum dag /'gro rnams byang chub thob phyir bsngo bar bgyi// lan gsum/ mchod gtor sman rak+ta byin rlabs ni/ a+ye| dung chen snod du mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i tshogs// sman raka gtor ma 'dod yon longs spyod bcas// dgra bgegs sha khrag ye shes bdud rtsi dngos// rmad byung zag med bde stong byin rlabs so// oṃ āḥhūm̐ ar+ghaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shapad/ a mṛ ta rak+ta ba liṃ/ sha trūṃ a mu kaṃ maṃ sa rak+ta dz+nyā nā mṛ ta oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ lan gsum/ brda sgo dbye ba ni/ a+ye/ rang rig gsal stong gdod nas chos kyi sku// rang mdangs rig rtsal 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed// yongs su grub kyang bar du rtog pas bsgribs// dus 'dir rang ngo shes phyir brda sgo dbye// bh+rūṃ dz+nyā na pra we sha ya phaṭa/

brda phyag 'tshal ba ni/ a+ye/ bdag dang gzhan dang snang srid 'khor 'das kun// rang sems 'od gsal ngang du sgyu ma'i rtsal// dbyer med don la bzang ngan spros bral yang*// rten 'brel rmad byung brda yi phyag bgyi'o// a ti pū hoḥ pra ti dzaḥhoḥ dam bca' ba ni/ a+ye/ ma rig 'khrul blos bslad pa'i sems can rnams| |ngan song gnas nas bsgral phyir sngags 'chang bdag /'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po bsgrub pa yi// ma grub bar du mi g.yel dam bca' 'o// sa ma ya bo dhi tsit+ta āḥ byin rlabs ni/ a+ye/ chos dbyings nam mkha' mtha' dbus bral ba'i klong*// longs sku sgyu 'phrul dam can srung ma'i tshogs// sna tshogs sprul bsgyur sprin rlangs na bun ltar// gtibs la 'dir byon dbang bskur byin phob cig /a+ye ya mā ri sa pa ri wā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa ā we sha ya pheṃ pheṃ/ zhes so// lha bskyed pa ni/ a+ye/ gzung 'dzin gnyis chos 'od gsal stong nyid ngang*// 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i 'gro drug snying rje'i yul// de nyid bsgral phyir rang rig rang rtsal mdangs// stong gsum mkha' khyab chos dbyings drag po'i zhing*// mthing nag gru gsum mtha' dbus bral ba'i dbus// rdo rje'i rwa gur mtshon cha me 'od 'phro// de nang rlung me chu sa'i dkyil 'khor steng*// sna tshogs rin chen las grub lhun po ni// che brjid rngam steng dur khrod 'bar ba'i dbus// dgra bgegs pho mo bsgrang yas bsnol ba'i steng*// rang rig 'od gsal spros bral rig rtsal mdangs// sgyu ma'i rnam rol gsal ba'i lha yi sku// skad cig nam mkhar glog 'gyu'i rnam pa ni// bcom ldan khro rgyal phyag rgya zil gyis gnon// dug chen ha la ha la ltar gnag cing*// dbu la lto 'gro sna tshogs gdengs ka ni// phyogs bcur g.yo zhing phud sgra dug rlangs 'phyo// spyan gsum dmar zhing bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar// bsgrad dang sdang mig zur gyis rab blta bas// rdo rje'i me dang gnam lcags lce 'bum 'bebs// shangs kyi rlung sgrom brdzes shing rbud pa las// bskal pa'i rlung nag g.yo bas srid gsum 'khrugs// zhal gdang mche ba zla tshes ltar gtsigs pas| |stong gsum zas dang srid gsum skom du 'debs// rdzi smin sma ra ag tshom dus mtha' yi// byin za ltar 'bar gza' skar thog ser 'bebs// dgra bgegs mgo bcad khrag rlon 'bab pa dang*// klu gnyan tshogs kyi phreng ba do shal 'phyang*// sku la dar nag lhug ber mnabs pa ni// nyi zla spangs pa'i mun pa ji bzhin rngam// phyag gnyis mchod rten me dang sa 'dzin dbang*// nam mkhar 'degs pas dgra bgegs gnon cing gzir// zhabs gnyis gyad kyi dor stabs dgra bgegs gnon// sbrul nag nag po'i mjug ma sar drud cing*// 'khyil bas srid gsum g.yo zhing dug dbal 'byin// ye shes rang 'od me dpung cher brjid rngam// las gshin ging bdud 'gugs gsod khram rtsis bdag

/sha za yi dwags bye ba 'bum gyis bskor// gzhan yang 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das pa'i// srung ma dam can rgya mtsho sprin ltar gtibs// bdag nyid thugs srog dwangs ma'i rang 'od 'di// glog gi lcags kyu lta bur phyogs bcur 'phros// ye shes sems dpa' 'khor bcas sa mā dzaḥ spyan drang ba ni sha chen gyi spos bsregs/ rdza rnga rkang gling gi sgra dang bcas pas/ a+ye/ rang bzhin rnam dag chos dbyings dag pa'i zhing*// ka dag klong nas sgyu ma'i skur bzhengs nas// khro rgyal phyag rgya zil gnon sprul 'khor bcas// drag po'i las la gnas 'dir spyan 'dren no// ya mān+ta ka sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ e h+ye hi/ bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ a+ye/ drag po dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i gshin rje'i gshed// gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i gzhal yas su// dgra bgegs gnod byed spungs pa'i gdan yangs par// phyag rgya zil gnon lha tshogs bzhugs su gsol// ya mān+ta ka sa pa riwā ra tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ phyag 'tshal ba ni/ a+ye/ rang rig rang rtsal chu la chu bur ltar| |rang snang rol pa'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas la// gnyis med mnyam pa chen po'i ngang nyid du// ma bcos 'du bral med par phyag bgyi'o// ya man+ta ka sa pa ri wā ra na mo na maḥ mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ a+ye/ mchod yon me tog spos dang mar me dri// zhal zas rol mo gzugs sgra dri ro reg /yid chos phyi mchod dngos 'byor yid sprul pa// stong gsum bkang ste zil gnon lha la 'bul// ya mān+ta ka sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ dī pe/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shapad/ rū pa/ shapad/ gan+dhe/ ra sa/ spar+she/ dharma dhā tu pū dza pra tīts+tsha hoḥ zhes phyi mchod dang*| a+ye/ stong gsum dang mnyam dung chen snod nang du// khrag chen ar+ghaṃ dbang po lnga'i me tog /sha chen spos dang tshil chen snang ba'i me// mkhris sbyar dri dang sha rus zhal zas tshogs| |thod rnga rkang gling dur khrod rdzas mchod 'bul// a ya mān+ta ka sa pa ri wā ra ma hā ar+ghaṃ/

puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ dī pe/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shapad pū dza pra tīts+tsha hoḥ zhes nang mchod dang*/ a+ye| phyag rgya rnam lnga'i snyoms 'jug nang mchod ni// gnyis med zung sbyor ma hā rā ga dang*// gzung 'dzin dgra bgegs ma rig bdud bsgral ba'i// gnyis 'dzin dug gsum mchod pa 'bul gyis bzhes// ya mān+ta ka sa pa ri wā ra ma hā maṃ sa/ rak+ta/ keṃ ni ri ti pū dza pra tīts+tsha hoḥ zhes gsang ba sbyor sgrol gyi mchod pa ni/ a+ye/ rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman chen po// myos byed stong gi bcud sbyar btung ba'i mchog /rgyu rkyen kun sbyar 'ben chen gsang ba'i khrag /snod bcud rdzogs pa ba liṃ gtor mar bcas// dam rdzas khyad par mchod pa chen po bzhes// ya mān+ta ka sa pa ri wā ra ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta/ ma hā ru dhī ra/ ma hā ba ling+ta pū dza pra tīts+tsha hoḥ zhes sman raka gtor gsum 'bul/ slar gtor mar sman raka sgron/ yang zlog gi drag po'i gtor ba byin rlabs ltar byas la/ a+ye ya mān+ta ka ya ma rā dza sa pa ri wā ra sha trūṃ a mu ka che ge mo'i maṃ sa/ rak+ta/ keṃ ni ri ti/ go ro tsa na/ tsit+ta/ ba su ta/ tsak+ṣuḥl kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes nyer gcig gis gtor ma 'bul/ 'dod gsol bya ba ni/ hoḥ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po phyag rgya zil gnon pa/ yab yum sras sprul 'khor tshogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la/ sman raka gtor ma dgra'i sha khrag bdud rtsi rgya mtsho chen po 'di 'bul lo bzhes shig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi/ mnyes shing tshims nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig pa/ dkon mchog gsum gyi dbu 'phang smad pa/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi thugs dkrugs pa/ rgyu 'bras khyad du bsad pa/ sngags 'chang bdag la do bsdos shing phod btsugs pa/ mi nga la lha med/ lha khyod la mthu med zer zhing mthu bu lon ltar bsnyags pa/ dam nyams pa'i dgra bo ming yi ger bris shing gzugs byang bur btab pa 'di mi tshe ring po la dus ma 'debs/

nam mkha' stong pa la tshad ma 'dzugs/ skye shi la khungs ma g.yor/ las dang las kyi rnam par smin pa la bsnyad ma 'dogs/ lo dang zla bar ma 'gyang*/ zhag dang za mar ma 'gor bar da lta nyid du dgra bo che ge mo'i dbugs bla srog rnam par shes pa dang bcas pa drag po'i rten liṅga 'di la khug cig /ma shor zhig /ma gtong zhig /sod cig /'di'i tshe srog dpal 'byor srog lus dbang thang rlung rta phun tshogs mthu stobs nus rtsal thams cad brlag par gyis shig /phung bar gyis shig /med par gyis shig /lus ngag yid gsum rnam par chings shig /gzir cig |gnon cig /bsam sbyor 'dun gros ngan gshom thams cad med par gyis shig /mi grub par gyis shig /phyes shig /dkrugs shig /gtor zhig /'di'i sha khrag gzugs phung bla tshe srog dbugs lhag ma med par zhal du btab bo// bzhes shig /rol cig /kha raṃ khā hi/ las la mthu ma chung zhig /rtsal ma zhan zhig /bang ma bul zhig /dgra bo 'di la than dang*/ ltas ngan/ dme 'khrug /nad mtshon/ dal yams/ mi rung mtshan ma ngan pa thams cad char ltar phob cig /mun ltar gtibs shig /dus la bab bo sa ma ya hoḥ zhes brjod/ bstod pa ni/ a+ye/ chos dbyings drag po e yi zhing khams su// rdo rje'i rwa gur ye shes me dpung 'bar// 'byung ba rim brtsegs lhun po brjid pa'i steng*| |rab 'jigs dur khrod rngam pa'i sa gzhi'i dbus// dgra bgegs kha sbub gan rkyal 'gyel ba'i steng*// dus gsum rgyal ba'i ye shes gcig bsdus pa// bcom ldan phyag rgya zil gnon khro bo'i rgyal// sku mdog nag po dug chen ha la'i mdog /lto 'gro'i gdengs kas steng gdon zil gyis gnon// spyan gsum gdang mig bar gdon thal bar rlog /rdzi ma sma ra ag tshom me ltar 'bar// zhal bgrad mche gtsigs ljags 'gyur dgra bgegs gsol// phyag gnyis ri rab mchod rten dgra bgegs gnon// sbrul dang thod phreng do shal rgyan du brjid| |dar nag lhug ber chu nag rlabs ltar g.yo// zhabs gnyis dor stabs dgra gdon gzir zhing sgrol// sbrul mjug g.yos pas 'og gdon rtsad nas 'byin// sku las me 'bar las nyon sdig sgrib sreg

/sku yi gar gyis sa gsum g.yo zhing 'gul// gsung gi nga ros khams gsum dbang du sdud// thugs kyi brtse khros srid gsum rjes su 'dzin// sbyor sgrol mkha' lding phyag rdor ya ma dang*// rus sbal khyung seng stag sbrul khro bo bcu// sprul pa rnam gsum gshed bzhi mon bdud dang*// 'chi bdag zhag gshed sgo skyong ma gshin ging*// sha za yi dwags 'byung po du ma'i 'khor// sprul pa yang sprul sna tshogs grangs 'das pa'i// phyag rgya zil gnon 'khor dang bcas pa la// lus ngag yid gsum dang bas phyag 'tshal bstod// phyi nang gsang mchod sman raka gtor ma sogs// dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di bzhes la// sngags 'chang bsam don bcol bskul gsol btab pa// drag po'i las 'di myur du 'grub par mdzod// ces bstod/ bshags pa ni/ bcom ldan phyag rgya zil gnon 'khor dang bcas// sngags 'chang bdag la gsan cing dgongs su gsol// lha mchog khyod bsten sgrub par dam bcas kyang*// ma rig 'khrul blos smin grol dam las 'gal// sku yi phyag rgya ma gsal gnyis 'dzin 'khrul// gsung gi bzlas brjod ma dag lhag chad nongs// thugs kyi ting 'dzin ma bsgom 'khrul par 'byams// rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig srung mtshams 'gal// rang gnong 'khrul pa'i bag med ci bgyis pa// gnong zhing 'gyod pas mi 'chab bshags par bgyi// bzod par bzhes la tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol// a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dz+nya na/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaḥ oṃ ya ma rā dza sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ sogs ya ma rā dza'i yig brgya brjod la bshags/ sngags bzlas pa'i 'od zer mtshon char spro ba sogs dang*/ lha sngags kyi man ngag tu bshad pa ltar dmigs pa gsal bas sngags la 'jug pa sogs gzhung dang man ngag ltar nyams su blangs shing*/ bskul ba ni/ hūm̐ */ mthing nag me dpung klong dkyil nas// zhes sogs logs su bris yod pa ltar btang ngo*/

dus mtha'i bstan srung du ba dum bu yi// las byang ngag bsgrigs khol bur byas pa 'di// dbur stod skyu ra'i sngags pa gyi na ba// srog gter gtad dang sdeb shog rlung gi las// sreg 'phang mnan dang cho 'phrul la sogs pa'i// drag po mngon spyod las la dbang 'byor ba// chos kyi grags pas rang bzo spangs te bris// dge bas snying po'i bstan pa 'phel ba dang*// log par lta kun de las zlog byed shog /ces pa shing sprel sa ga'i nyer bdun la sra brtan rdo rje'i gnas su mgyogs par bris so// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
